workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the overlapping free 30-min slots for both of them:

- Mon 09:00-10:00 (60 min available)
- Tue 13:00-14:00 (60 min available)
- Tue 16:30-17:00 (30 min available)
- Wed 15:00-16:00 (60 min available)
- Thu 10:00-10:30 (30 min available)
- Fri 11:00-12:00 (60 min available)

Brad, please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against these slots and let me know which ones work for all four partners. I recommend we prioritize the longer slots (Mon 09:00, Tue 13:00, Wed 15:00, Fri 11:00) as they give more flexibility.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots you identified work for both Elena and David. Here's why:

- Mon 09:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy (they have back-to-back meetings 09:00-10:00)
- Tue 13:00-14:00: Both Elena and David are busy entire slot
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Both Elena and David are busy
- Wed 15:00-16:00: David busy entire slot, Elena busy 15:30-16:00
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena busy (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David are busy

However, here are the overlapping free slots for Elena and David:
- Mon 11:00-12:00 (60 min)
- Tue 09:00-10:00 (60 min)
- Wed 13:00-14:00 (60 min)
- Thu 09:30-10:00 (30 min)
- Thu 14:30-15:30 (60 min)
- Fri 15:00-16:00 (60 min)

Can you check Priya and Marcus's calendars to see if any of these times work for them? We need to find a slot where all four can meet.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've checked your suggested slots against Priya and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately none of them work either:

- Mon 11:00-12:00: Priya busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00), Marcus busy 11:30-12:00
- Tue 09:00-10:00: Priya busy (Board prep 09:00-09:30, Partner lunch 09:30-10:00), Marcus busy (Recruiting call 09:00-09:30, Litigation strategy 09:30-10:00)
- Wed 13:00-14:00: Priya busy (Client call 13:00-13:30, Client dinner prep 13:30-14:00), Marcus busy (Partner lunch 13:00-13:30, Litigation strategy 13:30-14:00)
- Thu 09:30-10:00: Priya busy (09:30-10:00), Marcus busy (Contract review 09:30-10:00)
- Thu 14:30-15:30: Marcus busy (Dentist 14:30-15:00, Board prep 15:00-15:30)
- Fri 15:00-16:00: Priya busy (Hiring panel 15:00-15:30, Contract review 15:30-16:00), Marcus busy (Travel 15:00-15:30, Busy 15:30-16:00)

This appears to mean there's no 30-minute slot where all four partners are free next week. Before we report infeasible, could you please double-check Elena and David's calendars to make sure you haven't missed any overlapping free slots? Specifically, could you check if they have any free time during:
- Mon 09:00-10:00
- Tue 13:00-14:00 or 16:30-17:00
- Wed 15:00-16:00
- Thu 10:00-10:30
- Fri 11:00-12:00

These are the only times Priya and Marcus are both free.
